title: Joining forces with Joe Carroll

blocks.x: When did you hook up with Joe Carroll?

Well, I hooked up with Joe, I think it was around right after I came back from being on the road with the trio. In fact, I used Joe and (?) together a couple of times. But mostly I used Jimmy Roberts on piano with Joe. Fielder(?) was with that Rock-and-Roll band. He went out there with... You know what band I'm talking about? Oh, let's see if I can think of the name of him! I can't think of the name of that band, but I think most of them got killed in a plane wreck out in the Midwest.
Do you know who I'm talking about?
I might know it if you told me, but I just can't call it. But anyway, I know you and Joe started appearing together and doing gigs.
Well, we started down here at the Loeb Center by what's his name...
But you were doing some gigs down in Jersey, too, I remember.

Yeah. We did those for Jack Livingston down in Jersey. He set up the library thing, because we used to... But anyway, that turned out pretty nice. I've got some nice pictures of Joe and myself together, so I'll show you some sometime. Now what are we doing?
